items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names like maxEncodedShapes, maxEdgesPerShape and shapeIDs say what they hold. Doc comments are present ("// Encode encodes the ShapeIndex.") and short comments mark non-obvious steps ("Sort shape IDs for deterministic output"). Single-letter e/d/s/p follow the package's own encoder/decoder style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: ShapeIndex Encode/Decode went into shapeindex.go instead of the requested shapeindex_encode.go. The diff also makes unrelated changes: rewrites maybeApplyUpdates, changes the makeIndexCell sentinel to math.MaxInt32, implements tracker.lowerBound. Per-shape decode boilerplate repeats across files.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Every length is bounded before allocation (maxEncodedVertices, maxEncodedCells, total vertex check) and sticky errors are checked; Loop/Polygon decode fixed to return early on errors. Risk: maybeApplyUpdates now returns early when status is 'updating', so a reader can see a half-built index.

items.name: Existing encodings and Shape interface unchanged
items.name_zh: 既有编码格式与 Shape 接口不变
items.evidence: Change is additive: new typeTagLoop=6 and typeTagLaxLoop=7 are below typeTagMinUser and no existing tag is renumbered. Polygon/Polyline wire formats are unchanged; Polygon.Decode was only split out into decodePolygon. The Shape interface is untouched.
